export const customerApi = 'https://gridex-fixture.invalid';
const demoEmail = 'demo@example.invalid';
const demoPassword = 'GridexDemo2026';
const token = 'synthetic-device-test-session';
let session: { access_token: string; user: { id: string } } | null = null;
const listeners = new Set<(event: string) => void>();

export function createAccountClient(_brand: string) {
  return {
    auth: {
      getSession: async () => ({ data: { session }, error: null }),
      refreshSession: async () => ({ data: { session }, error: null }),
      async signInWithPassword({ email, password }: { email: string; password: string }) {
        if (email !== demoEmail || password !== demoPassword) {
          return { data: { session: null }, error: new Error('Use the demo credentials') };
        }
        session = { access_token: token, user: { id: 'synthetic-demo-customer' } };
        return { data: { session }, error: null };
      },
      async signOut(_options: { scope: string }) {
        session = null;
        for (const listener of listeners) listener('SIGNED_OUT');
        return { error: null };
      },
      onAuthStateChange(listener: (event: string) => void) {
        listeners.add(listener);
        return { data: { subscription: { unsubscribe: () => { listeners.delete(listener); } } } };
      },
      startAutoRefresh() {},
      stopAutoRefresh() {},
    },
  };
}

const invoice = {
  reference: 'demo-invoice-001', number: 'DEMO-001', status: 'issued', currency: 'SEK',
  amount: 125, dueDate: '2026-11-30', paidAt: null,
};
const rows = {
  contracts: [{ reference: 'demo-contract-001', name: 'Rörligt månadspris (test)', status: 'active', startDate: '2026-11-01' }],
  sites: [{ reference: 'demo-site-001', address: 'Testgatan 1', postalCode: '123 45', city: 'Teststad', facilityId: 'DEMO-001', priceArea: 'SE3', status: 'active' }],
  invoices: [invoice],
  invoiceDetail: [{
    ...invoice, issuedAt: '2026-11-10', periodStart: '2026-10-01', periodEnd: '2026-10-31',
    lines: [{ reference: 'demo-line-001', description: 'Elhandel (test)', quantity: 100, unitPrice: 1, amountExVat: 100, vatAmount: 25, amountIncVat: 125 }],
    documents: [],
  }],
};

function response(status: number, body: unknown) {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(body), { status, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
}

export function installDemoTransport() {
  globalThis.fetch = async (input, init) => {
    if (init?.signal?.aborted) throw new Error('Request aborted');
    const url = new URL(typeof input === 'string' ? input : input instanceof URL ? input.href : input.url);
    if (url.origin !== customerApi) return response(404, { error: 'No external network in this demo' });
    if (!session || new Headers(init?.headers).get('Authorization') !== `Bearer ${token}`) return response(401, { error: 'Sign in first' });
    if ((init?.method ?? 'GET') !== 'GET') return response(405, { error: 'Read-only demo' });
    const prefix = '/api/mobile/customer/';
    if (!url.pathname.startsWith(prefix)) return response(404, { error: 'Unknown resource' });
    const path = url.pathname.slice(prefix.length);
    if (path === 'invoices/demo-invoice-001') return response(200, { data: { invoiceDetail: rows.invoiceDetail } });
    if (['contracts', 'sites', 'invoices'].includes(path)) {
      return response(200, { data: { [path]: rows[path as 'contracts' | 'sites' | 'invoices'] } });
    }
    if (['profile', 'notifications', 'documents', 'powers', 'acceptances', 'support'].includes(path)) {
      return response(200, { data: { [path]: [] } });
    }
    return response(404, { error: 'Unknown resource' });
  };
}
